title: Karabasan's Poison
summary: Single-use weapon coating that can leave enemies Poisoned and Paralysed. The bottle can also be thrown.

fields.Coat: Bonus Action. Coats the active weapon set for 10 turns. This includes both hands when dual wielding. Each set requires its own dose. A coating replaces a dip.
fields.On hit: DC 13 Constitution save. Failure makes the target Poisoned and Paralysed until it succeeds on an end-of-turn Constitution save. Success against the coating makes it immune to Crawler Mucus for 2 turns.
fields.Throw: Action, up to 60 ft. A failed DC 13 Constitution save against the immediate blast causes Poisoned and Paralysed until a successful end-of-turn save or Long Rest. The 3 ft radius cloud lasts 1 turn and uses DC 11 Constitution. The coatings table lists a 1-turn condition from the cloud. The linked condition description says it ends on a successful Constitution save.
fields.Crafting and acquisition: This named version cannot be crafted. Buy it from Sister Lidwin in the House of Healing.
fields.Base value: 50 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
